guidelines.title: RateUrProfs Official Posting Guidelines ("Site Guidelines")
guidelines.subtitle: Official rules, civility standards, and moderation guidelines for the RateUrProfs website, applications, and interactive academic services.
guidelines.introTerms: These are the official posting guidelines ("Site Guidelines") for the RateUrProfs website (rateurprofs.site) and related services. RateUrProfs is owned and operated by RateUrProfs ("we," "us," or "our"), and these Site Guidelines are a part of, and Additional Terms under, our Terms of Use Agreement.
guidelines.missionDesc: RateUrProfs is the nationwide academic evaluation platform for students to research, rate, and discuss university professors and higher education institutions across Vietnam. Our mission is to provide a safe, respectful, and constructive forum to share authentic classroom experiences to help fellow students make critical academic choices.
guidelines.siteAppDesc: The RateUrProfs website (rateurprofs.site) and platform provide user-generated feedback on professors' teaching methods, course difficulty, grading fairness, and academic accessibility, as well as user-generated evaluations of university facilities, campus life, and educational environments.
guidelines.eligibilityDesc: Professor ratings should only be posted by users who have taken a class from the professor or who are currently taking a class with the professor. For each course a professor teaches, users are strictly limited to posting one (1) comment. Campus ratings should only be posted by students who have attended or are currently attending the specific course, college, or university being rated.
guidelines.emergencyDesc: RateUrProfs is NOT the place to report dangerous, illegal, or illicit behaviors. If you believe that you, another student, or a professor is in danger, we strongly advise you to report such incidences directly to your university administration, campus security, or local law enforcement authorities.
guidelines.howWeWorkDesc: RateUrProfs maintains a dedicated team of moderators and automated filters to evaluate every rating submitted. We have defined site guidelines to help reinforce our mission and, most importantly, to ensure our moderation decisions are 100% consistent, regardless of student or professor.
guidelines.noEditGuarantee: Our moderators are experts on our guidelines and will remove any comment that does not comply. Moderators will NEVER edit the wording of a rating to make it comply or remove a rating simply because it is a low score or negative review.
guidelines.flaggingPrompt: Did we miss something? If you feel an inappropriate comment should be removed from the site, you can flag it for re-review. It will immediately be escalated to our moderation queue for evaluation.
guidelines.studentGuideline1Desc: You want to be able to trust these reviews when evaluating your course options, so we ask that you contribute in that exact same spirit of academic integrity.
guidelines.studentGuideline2Desc: When reviewing a class and/or professor, it is often helpful to provide both pros and cons. This leads to much more credible, balanced, and constructive feedback for your peers.
guidelines.studentGuideline3Title: Focus on the Course & Learning Experience
guidelines.studentGuideline3Desc: Reviews should focus specifically on the course curriculum, syllabus, and your learning experience. Do not comment on a professor's physical appearance, clothing, age, gender, or race.
guidelines.studentGuideline4Desc: We want you to share your individual firsthand experience and what you took away from the course. Do not speak on behalf of others; encourage them to submit their own independent reviews.
guidelines.studentGuideline5Title: This Is Not a Forum for Debate
guidelines.studentGuideline5Desc: Reviews that specifically reference, quote, or dispute another review will be removed. If you do not agree with someone's individual experience, we encourage you to share your own.
guidelines.studentGuideline6Desc: We understand that not all instructors are the perfect match for each individual learning style. Tell us how the course or professor was or wasn't the best for you in a constructive manner that helps others make their own decision.
guidelines.studentGuideline7Desc: Reviews fueled by anger do not reflect well on the author and can be removed for violations such as profanity or hostility. Take a minute to step back and make sure your review will genuinely help others understand your experience.
guidelines.studentGuideline8Desc: RateUrProfs reserves the right to remove ratings that do not contain substantive comments, or that contain gibberish or spam characters.
guidelines.studentGuideline9Title: One Review Per Course & No Dogpiling
guidelines.studentGuideline9Desc: We only allow one student to review a professor one time per course. Spamming, brigading, or dogpiling an account will lead to comment removal and the offending account/IP being temporarily or permanently locked.
guidelines.studentGuideline10Desc: When reading fellow student reviews, we encourage you to use your discretion and weigh every review amongst the others. Online reviews should be one of many resources used when making academic decisions.
guidelines.prohibitedContentDesc: Comments that contain any of the following violations will be removed promptly:
guidelines.prohibited1: Profanity, name-calling, vulgarity, or derogatory remarks regarding ethnicity, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, physical appearance, age, or mental/physical disabilities.
guidelines.prohibited2: Personally identifiable information about a professor or student that would allow someone to contact them outside academic channels (e.g., private phone numbers, home addresses, personal emails, private social media).
guidelines.prohibited3: References to a professor's or student's family, personal life, relationships, and/or sex life, including sexual innuendos.
guidelines.prohibited4: Claims that a professor shows bias or discrimination for or against a student or specific group of students (such grievances should be reported through official university channels).
guidelines.prohibited5: Claims about a professor's employment status, salary, contract disputes, tenure status, or previous employment.
guidelines.prohibited6: Claims alleging that a professor or student engages or has engaged in illegal activities or criminal conduct.
guidelines.prohibited7: Direct references to other existing reviews or comments that have been deleted by our moderators.
guidelines.prohibited8: Accusations that the professor is rating him/herself or his/her colleagues.
guidelines.prohibited9: A language other than Vietnamese or English. Comments must be written in Vietnamese or English only.
guidelines.prohibited10: Hyperlinks, commercial advertisements, paid document links, or exam/course cheating services.
guidelines.professorGuideline1Desc: This is an anonymous website where students can share classroom experiences. We are unable to provide identity data or personal information about the submitter of a review, except under valid legal process.
guidelines.professorGuideline2Desc: Profiles and course catalogs are gathered from official university public catalogs (.edu.vn) or submitted by our student community.
guidelines.professorGuideline3Desc: We are unable to remove a comment simply because it is negative or critical. A comment will only be removed if it violates our Site Guidelines.
guidelines.professorGuideline4Desc: We encourage you to engage with students on the site. With a verified Professor account, you have the ability to post official replies and receive alerts when new ratings are posted on your profile.
guidelines.professorGuideline5Desc: Replies fueled by anger do not reflect well on the author and can be removed for violations such as profanity. Professor replies are subject to the same limitations regarding Prohibited Content set forth above.
guidelines.professorGuideline6Title: We Are Not Arbiters of Facts
guidelines.professorGuideline6Desc: The RateUrProfs moderation team is unable to prove or disprove details mentioned in a review or arbitrate pedagogical disputes. If you disagree with details in a review, you may post a clarifying reply or request an academic data correction.
guidelines.professorGuideline7Desc: If you believe your profile is being spammed, brigaded, or dogpiled, please contact us at support@rateurprofs.site. We are here to help and will gladly review the comments in question.
guidelines.professorGuideline8Desc: While it is against our guidelines for a professor to rate themselves, we recommend that professors encourage their students to provide ratings each semester. The larger the feedback pool, the more representative it will be.
guidelines.flaggingRatingDesc: If you see a rating that you believe violates these Site Guidelines, please click "Report this rating" at the bottom of the comment and state the specific problem. Such comments will be evaluated by site personnel. Please do not flag a rating just because you disagree with it.
guidelines.legalStuffDesc1: RateUrProfs occasionally receives removal demands that include threats of lawsuits. The law protects platforms like RateUrProfs from legal liability for content submitted by third-party users. Specifically, under applicable statutory frameworks governing internet information services (including Vietnamese Decree No. 72/2013/ND-CP, Decree No. 27/2018/ND-CP, and international safe harbor provisions such as Section 230 of the CDA), RateUrProfs operates as an intermediary hosting provider and is legally protected from liability for subjective evaluations submitted by third-party users.
guidelines.legalStuffDesc2: The law is clear on this. Anyone who wishes to sue RateUrProfs for reviews posted by community members risks penalties and sanctions imposed by the court. These may include financial sanctions and reimbursement of attorney fees and expenses incurred in defending against lawsuits that ignore statutory protections.
guidelines.legalProcessDesc: If you intend to serve formal legal process or statutory takedown notices on RateUrProfs, please ensure service is properly effected via our designated legal desk at admin@rateurprofs.site (for community moderation and review disputes, contact support@rateurprofs.site). We are not obligated to respond if service is invalid.
guidelines.legalDisclaimer: These guidelines are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute legal advice. While we stand by our guidelines, you are encouraged to seek independent counsel from an attorney competent in the relevant field of law.
guidelines.reservationOfRightsDesc1: RateUrProfs reserves the right to remove any comments deemed inappropriate, libelous, defamatory, indecent, vulgar, obscene, pornographic, sexually explicit, racially or ethnically offensive, harmful, harassing, intimidating, threatening, hateful, discriminatory, or abusive, or that otherwise violate our Terms of Use.
guidelines.reservationOfRightsDesc2: RateUrProfs reserves the right to remove content, provide records to authorities, or otherwise take appropriate legal action regarding comments that threaten violence or bodily harm to another user or professor, including notifying authorities of your IP address and timestamps.
guidelines.principle1Desc: Reviews should focus on pedagogy, lecture clarity, fairness of grading, assignment load, and student accessibility. Avoid emotional comments unrelated to the learning experience.
guidelines.principle2Title: 2. Zero Tolerance for Harassment & Personal Attacks
guidelines.principle2Desc: Hostile remarks, derogatory comments on physical appearance, ethnicity, religion, or gender identity are strictly prohibited.
guidelines.principle3Desc: Publishing personal telephone numbers, home addresses, family details, or private off-campus affairs will result in immediate content removal and permanent account bans.
guidelines.principle4Title: 4. Academic Honesty: One Review per Student
guidelines.principle4Desc: Each student may submit only one review per professor to safeguard against vote manipulation, coordinated brigading, or artificial inflation.
guidelines.moderationProcessDesc: The moderation board investigates all flagged reports. Faculty members and university administrators may request factual corrections or submit official responses through our verified support desk.

privacyPolicy.title: RateUrProfs Privacy Policy & Notice of Privacy Rights
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Official Privacy Policy explaining our information collection, usage, disclosure, and data protection practices for the RateUrProfs website, applications, and interactive academic services.
privacyPolicy.securityNoticeText: RateUrProfs is dedicated to protecting student anonymity and personal data privacy. We comply with Vietnamese Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection, the Law on Cybersecurity, and international privacy standards (CCPA & GDPR). We never sell your personal information or disclose student reviewer identities to institutions or instructors.
privacyPolicy.highlightsSubtitle: A quick reference summary of how your personal information is handled. Please read the full policy below for complete details.
privacyPolicy.sec1Text: This Privacy Policy applies regardless of whether you access the Site via a personal computer, mobile device, or other technology; whether you are a registered user or a casual visitor; to all information collected by the Site; and remains in full force and effect even if your account or participation terminates. It does not apply to third-party services or external websites linked from the Site.
privacyPolicy.sec2Text: The Site is operated in accordance with the laws of Vietnam, including Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection and the Law on Cybersecurity. If you access the Site from outside Vietnam (including international exchange students or overseas faculty), you do so at your own initiative, and your data is processed under applicable Vietnamese and international data transfer frameworks.
privacyPolicy.sec3Text: We collect information you provide directly (such as username, email address, OAuth profile tokens, university affiliation, courses attended, and submitted reviews) and automated technical information (such as browser cookies, IP address, device identifiers, operating system, and page interaction telemetry). We do not knowingly collect sensitive personal data such as political opinions, religious beliefs, or genetic data.
privacyPolicy.sec4Text: We use collected information to authenticate accounts, display and curate academic evaluations, verify email validity, respond to support and dispute inquiries, improve platform performance, deliver localized academic insights, and enforce site security and anti-spam protections.
privacyPolicy.sec5Text: You can opt out of non-essential communications using the unsubscribe mechanism in emails. You can configure your browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) to block or delete cookies, though certain interactive features such as session persistence and rating drafts may require cookies to function correctly.
privacyPolicy.sec6Text: This section is intentionally reserved for statutory indexing alignment with historical policy revisions.
privacyPolicy.sec7Text: We never sell personal information to third parties. We only disclose information: (a) publicly for review posting content (under your chosen pseudonym); (b) to trusted operational service providers (cloud infrastructure, database hosting) under strict confidentiality agreements; (c) to comply with lawful subpoenas, court orders, or emergency threat prevention; and (d) in connection with corporate restructuring or asset transfer.
privacyPolicy.sec8Text: Registered users can update their profile information and preferences at any time in Account Settings. You may request account deletion or data erasure by emailing security@rateurprofs.site. Note that authentic academic reviews contribute to public educational transparency and may be retained in anonymized format in accordance with statutory archival obligations.
privacyPolicy.sec9Text: We enforce enterprise-grade security including HTTPS/TLS 1.3 encryption, tokenized OAuth 2.0 sessions, and access control. Notice on Phishing: RateUrProfs will NEVER send you an email asking for your password, bank details, or credit card numbers. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, report it immediately to security@rateurprofs.site. All legitimate automated notifications originate strictly from no-reply@rateurprofs.site.
privacyPolicy.sec10Title: 10. Notice of Privacy Rights (Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, CCPA & GDPR)
privacyPolicy.sec10Text: Under Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection, CCPA & GDPR, data subjects possess 11 statutory rights under Article 9 (know, consent, access, withdraw consent, delete, restrict processing, data provision, object, complain/sue, claim damages, self-protect) and obligations under Article 10. To exercise these rights, contact security@rateurprofs.site.
privacyPolicy.sec11Text: For users residing in jurisdictions with specialized privacy frameworks (such as California, Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, the EU/EEA under GDPR, or ASEAN member states), we afford full parity of rights regarding data access, opt-out of profiling, and automated decision-making protections.
privacyPolicy.sec12Text: RateUrProfs reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Material revisions will be announced via prominent notice on the Site homepage or via email to registered users. Your continued use of the platform after updates indicates your agreement to the revised policy.
privacyPolicy.sec13Text: This Privacy Policy constitutes the sole authoritative statement of our data practices. For inquiries or data protection requests, contact: RateUrProfs Data Protection Office, Email: security@rateurprofs.site. This document is incorporated into and governed by the RateUrProfs Terms of Use Agreement.

It is incorporated into and forms an integral part of our Terms of Use Agreement. Both agreements are legally binding on all users. copyrightPolicy.sec3Title: 3. How to Submit a Notice of Copyright Infringement (Takedown Notice)
copyrightPolicy.sec3Text: If you are a copyright owner or an authorized agent who holds a good-faith belief that content hosted on RateUrProfs infringes your exclusive rights, submit a written notification containing: (1) A physical or electronic signature of the authorized copyright owner; (2) Specific identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed (or a representative catalog); (3) Specific identification and exact URL location of the allegedly infringing material on our Site; (4) Complaining party contact info (full name, address, telephone, email); (5) A statement that you have a good-faith belief that use of the material is not authorized by the owner, agent, or the law; and (6) A statement under penalty of perjury that the information in the notification is accurate and that you are authorized to act.
copyrightPolicy.sec4Text: Upon receipt of a compliant infringement notice, RateUrProfs will expeditiously remove or disable access to the identified material within statutory intermediary timelines (normally 72 hours under Decree No. 17/2023/ND-CP). We will also promptly dispatch written notice sent from no-reply@rateurprofs.site to the user who submitted the content at their registered email address.
copyrightPolicy.sec5Text: If you believe your content was removed or disabled as a result of mistake or misidentification, you may submit a formal counter-notice to our Designated Agent. The counter-notice must include: (1) Your physical or electronic signature; (2) Identification of the removed material and the specific URL location where it appeared; (3) A statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good-faith belief the material was removed by mistake or misidentification; and (4) Your full name, physical address, telephone number, and consent to legal jurisdiction and service of process.
copyrightPolicy.sec6Text: Upon receiving a valid counter-notice, RateUrProfs will forward a complete copy to the original complaining party. Unless the copyright owner notifies us within 10 to 14 business days that they have filed a formal court action seeking a restraining order against the user, RateUrProfs reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to restore the removed content.
